items.t: Intake manifold gasket leaks coolant
items.job: Replace intake manifold gaskets and coolant
items.note: Based on YourMechanic (no parts-plus-labor source found): about $100 parts on average; 1996-2003 Sonoma estimates $610-$790, shop/dealer $665-$1,079 (4.3L V6 costs more than the 2.2L). Change the oil too if coolant got into it.

items.t: ABS warning light on from brake control module failure
items.note: Based on RepairPal (no parts-plus-labor source found): $656-$1,081 for a Sonoma; the twin GMC Jimmy shows $642-$1,717 on 2000-2001 trucks. A wheel speed sensor costs far less if that is the cause.

items.t: Fuel pump fails or fuel gauge reads wrong
items.job: Replace fuel pump and sending unit assembly
items.note: Based on estimator totals (no parts-plus-labor source found). YourMechanic: $581-$1,454 for 1991-2002 trucks. RepairPal fuel level sending unit (usually replaced with the pump): $986-$1,540 depending on year. Extended cab trucks take longer.

items.t: Engine loses power from clogged fuel pump strainer
items.job: Replace in-tank fuel pump and strainer
items.note: Based on estimator totals (no parts-plus-labor source found). YourMechanic fuel pump: $581-$1,454 for 1991-2002 trucks; RepairPal sending unit on a 2000: $1,396-$1,540.

items.t: Misfire from worn distributor cap and rotor
items.job: Replace distributor cap, rotor and plug wires
items.note: Based on YourMechanic spark plug wire estimates ($247-$300 for 1997-2003 trucks; about $45 parts on average). A distributor cap and rotor add a modest parts cost.

items.t: Random misfire code with no misfire felt
items.job: Check engine light diagnosis per GM bulletin
items.note: Diagnosis only (RepairPal: $122–179).

items.t: Clicks but won't crank in cold weather
items.note: Diagnosis only (RepairPal: $122–179). The repair cost depends on what is found.

items.t: Outside door handle breaks
items.note: Based on YourMechanic (no parts-plus-labor source found): about $31 parts on average; $207-$245 for 1999-2002 trucks.

items.t: Front brake caliper sticks
items.note: Based on YourMechanic (no parts-plus-labor source found): about $60 parts on average; $383-$400 per caliper on 1997-2003 trucks. Replacing in pairs and bleeding the brakes adds cost.

items.t: Heater or fan stops working on some speeds
items.note: RepairPal estimates $96–139 total. A blower motor costs more.

items.t: Flex-fuel sensor fails on the 2.2L
items.note: Owners report about $500 total.

items.t: Fuel tank rusts through and leaks
items.note: Owners report about $1,000 total; the pump is often replaced at the same time.

items.t: Brake line can rub on the oil pan (recall)
items.note: Free at a GMC dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Seat belt webbing may separate (recall)
items.note: Free at a GMC dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Brake pipe nuts may loosen and leak (recall)
items.note: Free at a GMC dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: ABS motor clip can disable ABS (recall)
items.note: Free at a GMC dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Door label shows wrong payload (recall)
items.note: Free at a GMC dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Seat belt buckles may not hold in a crash (recall)
items.note: Free at a GMC dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Airbag warning label has wrong information (recall)
items.note: Free at a GMC dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Automatic transmission slips or loses gears
items.note: Twin of the Chevrolet S-10. Powertrain Products lists a remanufactured 4L60-E for the S10/Sonoma at $2,199. Labor hours follow the S-10 and GMC Jimmy entries (same transmission); no book-hour source was found. A used transmission costs less but carries more risk.

items.t: Four-wheel drive won't engage or works on and off
items.job: Replace front axle actuator (if testing confirms it)
items.note: Dorman 600-102 front 4WD actuator listed for 1991-2004 Sonoma at about $65 (MSRP about $160). If the transfer case shift motor or control module is the cause, the cost is different, so have it tested first. Labor follows the twin GMC Jimmy entry; no book-hour source was found.

items.t: Steering gearbox leaks and gets loose
items.job: Replace power steering gearbox (or reseal if only leaking)
items.note: Based on YourMechanic (no parts-plus-labor source found): about $253 parts on average; $696-$725 for 1998-2000 trucks, shop/dealer $825-$1,236. A seal kit alone costs less.

items.t: Alternator fails
items.note: Parts: Go-Parts lists new aftermarket alternators for 1991-2004 Sonoma at $83-$453 (used OEM $40-$100). YourMechanic cross-check: $497-$563 for 1999-2000 trucks, shop/dealer up to $984; labor hours not stated, so hours are based on its about $140 labor average.
